# PHP's own sqlite corpus: the tests that fail under the shim and PASS under
# stock sqlite. CI measures this on every run against the php-src tag matching
# the runner's interpreter — php-8.3.6 as of writing: 133 tests from
# ext/pdo_sqlite and ext/sqlite3, plus the shared PDO suite that
# pdo_sqlite/tests/common.phpt redirects into, 217 executed in all. Stock
# sqlite fails zero of them.
#
# A test reached through that redirect is reported under the directory that
# redirected to it, so the four bug_* entries below name ext/pdo_sqlite/tests
# while the files live in ext/pdo/tests. That is run-tests' naming, not a typo.
#
# One test SKIPS under the shim and runs under stock sqlite:
# ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_42589.phpt, whose SKIPIF greps PRAGMA
# compile_options for ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA. We do not advertise it, so the
# test declines to run. CI prints it every time rather than letting a skip
# pass for agreement.
#
# This list exists so a NEW failure is visible. It is not a target to keep at
# zero by deletion — a line removed without the test passing is a lie the next
# person inherits.
#
# Classified by inspection. None of these returns wrong DATA silently: every
# one is a refusal, a message difference, a missing feature or metadata. That
# is the property worth defending, and the reason this list is tolerable.
#
#   feature not implemented — real work, tracked separately
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/gh9032.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/gh9032.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_25_create_aggregate.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_38_backup.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_40_setauthorizer.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_defensive.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_trampoline_create_aggregate.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/sqlite3_trampoline_create_collation.phpt
#
#   rigid typing: mpedb REFUSES a comparison sqlite coerces. Loud, not silent.
ext/sqlite3/tests/bug73068.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/bug73333.phpt
ext/sqlite3/tests/gh20699.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_71885.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_72368.phpt
#
#   error text differs, both engines refuse
#   (four left here when the authorizer stopped rewriting compile errors and
#   the duplicate-table refusal learned to name its table)
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug38334.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_34630.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/bug_36798.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/common.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/pdo_fetch_func_001.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/pdo_sqlite_filename_uri.phpt
ext/pdo_sqlite/tests/pdo_sqlite_transaction.phpt
#
#   (extended result codes used to sit here — sqlite3_extended_result_codes()
#   was a no-op, so sqlite3_errcode() gave 19 where sqlite gives 1555. Fixed;
#   both tests pass. Left as a note because "coarser, never wrong" is the kind
#   of gap that stays put until someone writes down what it costs.)
